reference_checks.check: Viewing an Available listing with offers enabled as a buyer displays the 'Make Offer' button.
Viewing an Available listing with 'Fixed price — no offers' enabled as a buyer hides the 'Make Offer' button.
Viewing a Reserved listing as a buyer hides the 'Make Offer' button.
Viewing a Sold listing as a buyer hides the 'Make Offer' button.
Viewing an Available listing as its own seller hides the 'Make Offer' button.
Tapping 'Make Offer' on an eligible Available listing while logged out prompts the user to log in.
Completing login with valid buyer credentials after tapping 'Make Offer' automatically returns the user to the Make Offer sheet pre-filled with the listing price.
Opening the Make Offer sheet on a $100 listing pre-fills the default offer amount with 100.
Attempting to submit an offer amount of 0 on a $100 listing is blocked by validation.
Attempting to submit a negative offer amount (< 0) on a $100 listing is blocked by validation.
Attempting to enter or submit a decimal offer amount of 50.50 on a $100 listing is blocked by validation.
Attempting to submit an offer amount of 101 (above the $100 listing price) is blocked by validation.
Submitting a valid whole-number offer of 100 (within 1 to 100) on a $100 listing is accepted.
Entering 49 in the offer amount field on a $100 listing displays the inline warning 'This offer is much lower than the asking price. The seller may be less likely to accept.'.
Tapping Submit on a $49 offer (<50% of a $100 listing price) succeeds despite the inline warning.
Submitting an $80 offer on a $100 listing with no prior chat creates a buyer-seller chat thread with the system message '[Buyer] offered $80'.
After submitting an $80 offer on a $100 listing and refreshing the listing page as the same buyer, the listing button changes to 'View your offer'.
Submitting an $80 offer triggers a push notification to the seller.
Submitting an $80 offer on a $100 listing fires the 'offer_submitted' analytics event with listing_id, offer_amount=80, and listing_price=100.
Accepting Buyer A's $80 pending offer changes Buyer A's offer status to Accepted.
Accepting Buyer A's $80 pending offer changes the listing status to Reserved.
Accepting Buyer A's $80 pending offer automatically changes Buyer B's competing $75 pending offer to Declined.
When Buyer B's competing $75 pending offer is automatically declined, Buyer B's chat displays the system message 'This item has been reserved for another buyer.'.
Accepting Buyer A's $80 pending offer sends a push notification to Buyer A.
Automatically declining Buyer B's competing $75 pending offer sends a push notification to Buyer B.
Accepting Buyer A's $80 pending offer fires the 'offer_accepted' analytics event.
Declining the buyer's pending $70 offer on a $100 listing changes the offer status to Declined.
Declining the buyer's pending $70 offer sends a push notification to the buyer.
Declining the buyer's pending $70 offer fires the 'offer_declined' analytics event.
After the seller declines the buyer's $70 offer, the 'Make Offer' button reappears on the listing page for the buyer.
After the buyer's $70 offer is declined, the buyer can successfully submit a new offer of $85 on the $100 listing.
When countering a buyer's $60 offer on a $100 listing, attempting to submit a counter amount of $60 (equal to or less than the buyer's offer) is rejected.
When countering a buyer's $60 offer on a $100 listing, attempting to submit a counter amount of $105 (above the $100 listing price) is rejected.
Submitting a counter-offer of $85 on a buyer's $60 offer for a $100 listing succeeds.
Submitting a counter-offer of $85 notifies the buyer.
Submitting a counter-offer of $85 fires the 'offer_countered' analytics event.
Viewing the seller's $85 counter-offer as the buyer allows only Accept or Decline with no option to submit a second counter-offer.
Accepting the seller's $85 counter-offer as the buyer sets the offer status to Accepted.
Accepting the seller's $85 counter-offer as the buyer sets the listing status to Reserved.
Advancing past 48 hours from submission of a pending offer with no seller response changes the offer status to Expired.
When a pending offer expires after 48 hours without response, both buyer and seller see the chat system message 'This offer has expired.'.
When a pending offer expires after 48 hours without response, the buyer receives a push notification.
When a pending offer expires after 48 hours without response, the 'offer_expired' analytics event fires.
After a pending offer expires, the buyer can navigate to the listing and submit a new offer.
Tapping Withdraw on a pending offer on Listing 1 changes the offer status to Withdrawn.
Withdrawing a pending offer on Listing 1 fires the 'offer_withdrawn' analytics event.
Viewing an accepted offer on Listing 2 does not permit the buyer to withdraw the offer.
Viewing a listing as the seller when there are 3 pending offers and 1 declined offer displays the badge 'Offers (3)' excluding the declined offer.
Opening the seller's offer inbox lists higher-amount pending offers before lower-amount offers ($90 offers from Buyer C and Buyer B before Buyer A's $70 offer).
Opening the seller's offer inbox breaks ties in offer amount by earliest submission time (Buyer C's $90 offer at 10:02 AM appears before Buyer B's $90 offer at 10:05 AM).

checklist_items.item: Eligibility: 'Make Offer' button is hidden when the listing status is not Available (Sold or Reserved).
Eligibility: 'Make Offer' button is hidden when the seller has enabled 'Fixed price — no offers'.
Eligibility: 'Make Offer' button is hidden when the viewer is the listing's own seller.
Eligibility: tapping 'Make Offer' while logged out redirects to login and returns the buyer to the offer sheet after authentication.
Amount boundary: offer amount of 0 is rejected.
Amount boundary: offer amount of 1 (minimum valid whole number) is accepted.
Amount boundary: offer amount equal to the listing price is accepted.
Amount boundary: offer amount of listing price + 1 is rejected.
Amount boundary: non-integer offer amount is rejected.
Amount boundary: offer amount of exactly 50% of the listing price does not show the lowball warning.
Amount boundary: offer amount just under 50% of the listing price shows the inline warning and can still be submitted.
One-pending-offer rule: a buyer can have only one pending offer per listing and sees 'View your offer' instead of 'Make Offer' while one is pending.
Accept cascade: accepting an offer automatically declines all other pending offers on the same listing.
Accept cascade: auto-declined competing buyers receive the system message 'This item has been reserved for another buyer.'.
Accept cascade: accepting an offer changes the listing status to Reserved.
Counter validation: counter amount must be strictly greater than the buyer's offer.
Counter validation: counter amount must be less than or equal to the listing price.
Counter limit: only one counter round is allowed; the buyer cannot counter a seller's counter-offer.
Expiry: a pending buyer offer expires after 48 hours without response.
Expiry: a pending seller counter-offer expires after 48 hours without response.
Expiry: after expiry, the buyer is allowed to submit a new offer.
Withdrawal: a buyer can withdraw a pending offer before the seller responds.
Withdrawal: a buyer cannot withdraw an offer once it has been accepted.
Seller inbox: 'Offers (N)' count reflects only pending offers.
Seller inbox: offers are sorted by amount descending (highest first).
Seller inbox: ties in offer amount are broken by earliest submitted first.
Analytics: 'offer_submitted' event fires with listing_id, offer_amount, and listing_price.
Analytics: 'offer_accepted' event fires with listing_id, offer_amount, and listing_price.
Analytics: 'offer_declined' event fires with listing_id, offer_amount, and listing_price.
Analytics: 'offer_countered' event fires with listing_id, offer_amount, and listing_price.
Analytics: 'offer_expired' event fires with listing_id, offer_amount, and listing_price.
Analytics: 'offer_withdrawn' event fires with listing_id, offer_amount, and listing_price.
Buyer push notification: triggered when the buyer's offer is accepted.
Buyer push notification: triggered when the buyer's offer is declined.
Buyer push notification: triggered when the buyer's offer is countered.
Buyer push notification: triggered when the buyer's offer expires.

traps.trap: Asserting as fact whether a seller can or cannot withdraw/undo an Accept (deliberately not specified).
Asserting as fact a maximum number of offers a buyer can make on a listing over time (deliberately not specified).
Asserting as fact specific currency formatting or decimal handling rules beyond requiring whole numbers (deliberately not specified).
Asserting as fact what happens to pending offers when the seller edits the listing price (deliberately not specified).
Asserting as fact whether a declined buyer is notified by a chat system message, since only a push notification is stated for decline (deliberately not specified).
Asserting that the buyer can counter the seller's counter-offer (explicitly forbidden by §3.3).
Asserting that an offer amount above the listing price is accepted (contradicts §3.2).
Asserting a 24-hour expiry or any expiry duration other than 48 hours (contradicts §3.4).
